# xdelta3 (decoder for the English patch)

Source files from https://github.com/jmacd/xdelta (`xdelta3/`), commit
e6f48d36007b4a62ab9a38d0db8bd0f710d2de3a, unchanged. Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`).

The launcher uses only the in-memory decoder (`xd3_decode_memory`) through `optroy_xd3.c`, to apply
the Eight Mansions English patch (xdelta files) that the player downloads themselves.
